Move a file and repair every specifier that names it

Usage: ryi move [OPTIONS] [OLD] [NEW]

Arguments:
  [OLD]  File to move (omit with --list)
  [NEW]  Destination

Options:
      --list <LIST>              TSV of old<TAB>new rows
      --root <ROOT>              Corpus root; repeatable
      --verify-cwd <VERIFY_CWD>  Directory --verify runs in (default: first root)
      --state <STATE>            Soopy state root, outside the corpus
      --commit                   Apply instead of dry run
      --shim                     Leave a reexport shim at OLD instead of rewriting importers
      --relocate-mod             Move a Rust module's `mod` line instead of adding #[path]
      --verify <VERIFY>          Command to run after --commit; failure rolls back
      --text-refs                Report leftover old-path spellings in plain text
  -h, --help                     Print help
